fato_historico: 2021: COVID-19 pandemic: The World Health Organization identifies the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant.
energia_do_dia: Today, your intuition may guide you toward profound internal discovery. Much like the world once learned to embrace change and new beginnings during a global shift, you are invited to evolve. It is a good time to release old patterns and consider how your unique presence can heal, transform, and bring hope to those around you.
frase_do_dia: The brightest stars are born from the deepest mysteries of the velvet night.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your inner wisdom and spiritual growth.
conselho: Embrace the unexpected changes today with an open heart and calm spirit.
